user.title: Garden watering
user.description: Rain data uses your Home Assistant home location. Add taps after setup from this integration's page.

data_description.forecast_source: Past rain always comes from Open-Meteo for your home location. The next 24 h can come from Open-Meteo or a weather entity with an hourly forecast.
data_description.cool_below: Today's forecast high below this is a cool day (default 16 °C).
data_description.hot_from: Today's forecast high at or above this is a hot day (default 23 °C). In between is a warm day.
data_description.backup_weather: Used when Open-Meteo is unreachable: the first that gives an hourly forecast supplies the next 24 h and today's high. Empty = every weather entity with an hourly forecast.
data_description.past_rain_sensor: Used when Open-Meteo is unreachable: its recorded history (mm/h) gives the rain of the past 24 h. Empty = the first current rain-rate sensor found.

error.weather_required: Choose a weather entity, or use Open-Meteo.
error.splits_order: Hot day must start above the cool day limit.

abort.already_configured: WaterHA is already set up. Add taps from its integration page.

data_description.flow_sensor: Needed for litres; also records how much water each run used.
data_description.rain_threshold: Skip a scheduled run when rain in the past 24 h plus the next 24 h forecast reaches this; less rain shortens the run in proportion (half the threshold = half the amount). 0 = ignore rain.
data_description.max_minutes: Safety limit: the tap closes after this long whatever happens.
data_description.amount_cool: Minutes or litres on a cool day (litres needs a flow-rate sensor).
data_description.amount_hot: The day type comes from today's forecast high and the splits set on the hub.
data_description.sequential: Wait for other one-at-a-time taps to finish, so taps set for the same time run one after another.
data_description.slot_2: Two daily slots, e.g. morning and evening; turn on either or both. Each slot that runs gives the full day-type amount (less for rain).

water_now.name: Water now
water_now.description: Open a WaterHA tap now for today's amount (by day type), or the amount given. Ignores rain.

entity_id.name: Tap
entity_id.description: The tap's switch or valve, or any of its WaterHA entities.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Minutes or litres; defaults to the tap's amount for today's day type.

mode.name: Water by
mode.description: Minutes or litres; defaults to the tap's setting.

stop.name: Stop watering
stop.description: Close the given taps, or every WaterHA tap.

entity_id.name: Tap
entity_id.description: Leave empty to stop all taps.
